root_cause: The onTabKeydown handler treats ArrowDown and ArrowUp as navigation between tabs, causing vertical arrow keys to change the selected tab in a horizontal tablist, contrary to the expected behavior where only left/right arrows move between tabs.
repair_strategy: Modify the onTabKeydown method to respond only to ArrowLeft/Left and ArrowRight/Right (and their legacy key names), ignoring ArrowUp/Down and Up/Down, thus making vertical arrow keys no-ops for the tablist while preserving horizontal navigation.

edits.before:
/**
   * Handle tab keydown event
   *
   * - Press right/down arrow for next tab
   * - Press left/up arrow for previous tab
   *
   * @private
   * @param {KeyboardEvent} event - Keydown event
   */
  onTabKeydown(event) {
    switch (event.key) {
      // 'Left', 'Right', 'Up' and 'Down' required for Edge 16 support.
      case 'ArrowLeft':
      case 'ArrowUp':
      case 'Left':
      case 'Up':
        this.activatePreviousTab()
        event.preventDefault()
        break
      case 'ArrowRight':
      case 'ArrowDown':
      case 'Right':
      case 'Down':
        this.activateNextTab()
        event.preventDefault()
        break
    }
  }
edits.after:
/**
   * Handle tab keydown event
   *
   * - Press right/left arrow for next/previous tab
   *
   * @private
   * @param {KeyboardEvent} event - Keydown event
   */
  onTabKeydown(event) {
    switch (event.key) {
      // 'Left' and 'Right' required for Edge 16 support.
      case 'ArrowLeft':
      case 'Left':
        this.activatePreviousTab()
        event.preventDefault()
        break
      case 'ArrowRight':
      case 'Right':
        this.activateNextTab()
        event.preventDefault()
        break
    }
  }

expected_accessibility_effect: Users can press the Down arrow without changing the selected tab, keeping the current tab panel visible; keyboard navigation remains operable via left/right arrows, conforming to ARIA authoring practices for a horizontal tablist.
functional_risks: Removing vertical arrow navigation may affect users who expect Up/DOWN to move focus in a vertical tablist, but this component is used only for horizontal tablists as per the supplied CSS.
Legacy Edge support for Up/DOWN keys is dropped, but LEFT/RIGHT keys remain supported.
verification_requirements: Pressing ArrowDown does not change focus or aria-selected attribute; the selected tab and its panel remain unchanged.
Pressing ArrowRight moves focus to the next tab, updates aria-selected, and shows the corresponding panel.
Pressing ArrowLeft moves focus to the previous tab, updates aria-selected, and shows the corresponding panel.
No JavaScript errors are thrown when pressing ArrowUp or ArrowDown.
Page scroll is not affected by ArrowUp/Down key presses.
